message.content: I have full artifact context. The kernel is a scalar recurrence (h[t] = a[t]*h[t-1] + b[t]) implemented in Triton on a single program, with the state h explicitly rounded to fp16 and back to fp32 at every step. That per-step fp16 quantization is the main numerical-risk surface against the E <= 0.003 budget. I'll record the description model now.
